_comment: Snake locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Do NOT translate the move/direction tokens the player types ([up], [down], [left], [right], w, s, a, d) or the ASCII board rendered into {board}.

_slots.{num_players}: Number of players in the match
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII grid; keep neutral, never translate its characters
_slots.{groups}: Neutral ranking data (a list of player-id groups, worst to best); do not translate

player_prompt.intro:
{num_players}-Akópa Snake lórí àpapọ̀ {width}×{height}.
Ìwọ ni ó ń ṣàkóso snake {player_id}. Ìgbéyẹ̀wọ̀ tó wúlò: '[up]'/'[down]'/'[left]'/'[right]' (tàbí w/s/a/d).
Èrò: gbé ìgbéyẹ̀wọ̀ tó pẹ́ jùlọ tàbí gbé ìgbéyẹ̀wọ̀ tó pẹ́ jùlọ àti gbà àwọn ìsọ̀rí tó ga jùlọ (ìdíwọ̀ ìgbà {max_turns} ìgbà).

game_action.invalid_death: Ejò {player_id} kú nítorí ìgbésẹ̀ tí kò bá ìlànà mu.

outcome.survived_win: Ẹlẹsẹ {player_id} yè; gbogbo àwọn yòókù kú.
outcome.all_dead_simul: Gbogbo àwọn ejò náà ló kú lẹ́ẹ̀kan náà.
outcome.outlived: Ọ̀jáfáfá ni, kò sí ẹni tó kú.
outcome.all_dead: Gbogbo àwọn ejò náà ti kú.
outcome.turn_limit: Ìlà ìyí ti dé - ẹni tó bá ní ìlà tó dára jù lọ ló máa gba ìyàsọ́tọ̀.
outcome.ranking: {reason} Awọn ẹgbẹ ipo ipari (ti o buru julọ→ti o dara julọ): {groups}
